case_title: ELIZABETH CHAN VS. EUROPEAN COLLISION CENTER, LLC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-18-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-18-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506.
